units.source_text: 且说朱雀院定于本月内移居寺中。

en.t: Now Suzaku-in had decided to move into the temple within this month.

units.source_text: 临别写了好几封诚恳的信给源氏。

en.t: Before parting, he wrote several earnest letters to Genji.

units.source_text: 信中所述，不消说是关于三公主之事。

en.t: What he wrote about in the letters was, needless to say, the matter of the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 他说：“吾弟不须顾虑我闻知后作何感想。

en.t: He said, "My brother, you need not worry about what I may think after hearing of it.

units.source_text: 无论何事，但照尊意教养此女可也。”

en.t: In all matters, simply raise this girl according to your own judgment."
He repeated these words several times.

units.source_text: 但因公主年幼，所以他心中还是十分惦念。

en.t: But because the princess was still young, he remained deeply anxious about her.

units.source_text: 他又特地写一信给紫姬，信中言道：“小女年幼无知，

en.t: He also wrote a special letter to Lady Murasaki, saying in it, "My little daughter is young and ignorant,

units.source_text: 托庇尊府，务望夫人怜其无罪，多多照拂。

en.t: and now depends on the shelter of your noble household; I earnestly hope that you will pity her innocence and look after her with great care.

units.source_text: 夫人与小女固有亲戚之谊也。

en.t: After all, you and my daughter are bound by ties of kinship."
